~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.

items.name: a snow white kaajkur bordered by a platinum-belled red velvet ribbon
raw_inspect: Crafted in the Finnian style and bedecked with platinum bells, the kaajkur bears a low-rise pommel and stirrups that hang down at a middling length.
The kaajkur can not be worn.
Analysis of a snow white kaajkur bordered by a platinum-belled red velvet ribbon indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--------- VIEW FROM A STAG SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This kaajkur is a View From a Stag saddle meant for use with "cervid" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this kaajkur:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target cervid} -- that are valid for this kaajkur's current setup are:  RIGHT; LEFT; POMMEL; MANE; JUMP; GRACE-L; GRACE-R
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this kaajkur's current setup are:  POMMEL; MANE, JUMP, SLIDE, GRACE-L, GRACE-R

The kaajkur can have various accessories added to it, if they were made specifically for a kaajkur:  a saddle pad, a saddle blanket, and either bells or trim.  If you have an accessory, you will need to hold both items and SLAP the saddle to add it; to remove an accessory, PRY for bells/trim, and PINCH or PINCH KAAJKUR WITH {PAD|BLANKET} for pad/blanket.  Some accessories change the long description.  This kaajkur currently has the following accessories attached:
*bell item (platinum bells)
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the kaajkur.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description being present because accessories can temporarily change the long description.
Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to kaajkur (Finnian).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  Its pommel is low-rise (doesn't really jut up vertically), and the cantle is what you'd expect from a "normal" saddle.  The stirrups are loose (no flaps).  It utilizes a billet and buckle girth type system for saddling.  It will usually include a pad or not use anything underneath at all.  It is somewhat light compared to other saddle styles.
You get no sense of whether or not the kaajkur may be further lightened.
The snow white kaajkur will cost 1,000,000 coins.
It appears to weigh about 3 pounds.
It is estimated to be worth about 0 silvers.
It has a temporarily unlocked loresong by Trace.

Analysis of a bear-shaped smooth blackened bone idol indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Animalistic Totem --
This idol is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==
* Spiritual Essences [5 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
POINT the idol at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the idol absorb some of the creature's essence.
If you have more than one spiritual essence slot unlocked, you can use TURN on the idol to switch between the stored essences.
* Ambient Messages [OFF - PROD to toggle]
While you are wearing the idol, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.
* Animalistic Decoration

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the idol and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the idol to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the idol to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the idol's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Unlocked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the idol to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the idol's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the idol to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.
* Movement Styles [Unlocked -] ON in "Animal Shadow" style, use COVER to toggle off.]
When unlocked, you can allow the spiritual essence inside the idol to affect how you look when you move from room to room.  SPIN will select a style, while COVER will toggle the feature off.
* Wear Location Change [Unlocked]
When unlocked, you can use FOLD on the idol to switch between pin, wrist, and neck-worn locations.
* Bestial Power [Unlocked - T5 of 5,] Animalistic Endurance.]  (Flares: OFF, RUB to toggle)
When unlocked, the spiritual essence inside the idol can help you passively in combat.  Only one of four paths can be chosen, and this cannot be changed once unlocked.
Abilities happen at a standard flare rate during combat if there are enough charges available.
Animalistic Endurance (Defensive) - +2 crit padding per tier.
Bestial Block (Defensive) - +3 DS/+2 TD per tier
Shifting Strike (Offensive) - +3 AS/+2 CS per tier
Feral Ferocity (Offensive) - +2 crit weighting per tier
The ability is fueled by skins from creatures, and up to 500 charges can be stored.
* Fluff Actions [Unlocked, T2 of 2.]
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations are fine, though the noun must be "idol", "totem", or "fetish".
* The adjective field should contain the material the idol is made of.
* This idol cannot accept a show description.

* Any willing merchant can change the designs for when feathers, bone/teeth, flowers, gems, bugs/sea creatures, or miscellaneous items are PUSHed into the idol.  These work much like Veolas, but the only part of the description you can customize is the part after the noun.
* Any willing merchant can change the color of the different spiritual essences.
==Usage==

You will find that you can use the following verbs: POINT (attune to a creature), ADD (add a material), PUSH (add a decoration), PULL (remove a current decoration), CLEAN (set material back to default), PROD (toggle ambient messages), TWIST (change between material and accent), FLIP (change accent design once accent is ADDed), TURN (change spiritual essence selected), SPIN (change movement style), COVER (toggle off movement style), FOLD (change wear location), PRAY, WAVE (targeted/untargeted), TOUCH, POKE, DROP/PUT (feed skins), RUB (toggle flares on/off).
You can TOSS the idol at a creature/object to send it in for review as a possible spiritual essence source.
